_ceiling_composition: setup and every core step at its bound ($1.4, 76.4 min at $1.09/h incl. disk), rounded up to the cent, + the $0.3 teardown reserve
rate_rule: re-quoted live at launch; the launcher derives the session ceiling and timeout from the live rate and refuses if the cap no longer buys the work
covers: stage V of topk_adoption_driver.py on one L40S pod: the steps of plan.json, nothing else
does_not_cover: a D2 search, recovery training or a behavioural probe
a second pod for a failed step without a recorded engineering cause
any spend above the all-in ceiling, cumulative across subruns
command: ADOPT_CAMPAIGN=logs/stages/stage-1/families/d_series/validations/d2-gpu-validation/v1/campaign.json ADOPT_COMMIT=<this grant's commit> ADOPT_BRANCH=exec/d1-behavioural-readiness ADOPT_STAGES=V ADOPT_PREDICTION_ROWS=all_v1 SESSION_CAP=1.40 bash scripts/stages/stage-1/phase_d1/topk_adoption_launch.sh d2val_<utc>
activation: the maintainer's grant is recorded by writing this record as authorization.json with status GRANTED, granted_utc and granted_by; until then engineering_campaign_budget.py cannot read a ceiling and the launcher creates nothing
on_ordinary_failure: repair and retry inside this ceiling (AGENTS.md P12.1); a deterministic paid failure is never retried unchanged
